_what: A battery of trap tasks for comparing two builds of an AI's behaviour (src/behavior-compare.mjs, scripts/compare-arms.mjs). Each task is drawn from a waste or failure that really happened (`class`, and `from` saying where it was seen) and is scored only from the calls a run recorded, never from what the run said about itself. A task's `scorers` all have to hold for it to score 1. Kinds: max_calls { n } (at most n recorded calls), forbids_tool { tool } (no call to it), requires_tool { tool } (at least one call to it), calls_before { first, then } (a call to `first` comes before any call to `then`), ends_in { state } (the run ended in that state). A task with no recorded run for an arm scores 0 for that arm and stays in the denominator, so a build that fails to run is counted, not dropped. A new trap is one row here.

tasks.from: an AI wrote to a record it had not read, then wrote again after the first write overwrote the person's change
the same search asked eleven times in one job
a send whose outcome was unknown was sent again
